title: Light Map config
description: The committed config document. Everything downstream is a pure function of it; learned data (almanacs) is not stored here. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (Top-level config shape) and docs/DESIGN.md (Data model).
$comment: Core sections (homeassistant, rooms, unassigned) are validated in depth as of P1; system, learning, schedule_profiles and adaptive_config fill in with the observer (P4) and the adaptive module (P5). Cross-references (ids unique within their scope; members and schedule_profile resolve) are checked by app/core/config.py, not here.

version.description: Schema version. The container migrates forward on load.

system.description: Observation cadence, reactive window and min-delta, data dir, CSV toggle, event-log retention. Field names are fixed with the observer (P4), which is the first thing to read them.

rooms.description: Rooms, from HA Areas: the committed snapshot of the resolved bulb->room mapping. Every HA Area is a room.

unassigned.description: The Unassigned bucket: bulbs whose light has no HA Area. Kept in the snapshot so a bulb's id and hard switches survive while it has no room. Not a room: no switching groups, no module config.

schedule_profiles.description: Reusable time-section schedules (adaptive module). A profile with id `default` must always exist.

learning.description: Adaptive analyser tuning. Field names are fixed when the analyser is ported (P5).

slug.description: Lowercase identifier, usable inside an HA object id (e.g. input_boolean.lm_soft_<id>).

entity_id.description: An HA entity id. Entity IDs only, never device IDs.

homeassistant.description: HA connection. LM_HA_BASE_URL, when set, overrides base_url; the token comes only from LM_HA_TOKEN (or LM_HA_TOKEN_FILE). Reconnect backoff settings arrive with the event subscription's reconnect loop (P4).

base_url.description: Used when LM_HA_BASE_URL is not set.

access_token.description: Never persisted: stripped on save and export, supplied at runtime from the environment or a secrets file.

room.description: A room is an HA Area. adaptive_config is required when adaptive is true and forbidden when false.

id.description: Stable for the room's life, through Area renames.

bulb.description: One light.* entity, the actuation atom. Its soft-switch helper is implicit (generated). Matched to HA by entity_id; its id and hard switches travel with it when it moves.

switching_group.description: A power fan-out: bulbs toggled together. Its soft switch is implicit (generated), modelled as an HA group of its members' soft switches.

hard_switch.description: A hard-switch binding, used inside bulbs[] and switching_groups[] (not on the room).

source.description: An entity_id, or an event/device reference. Shape is fixed in P2.

schedule_profile.description: Id of an entry in schedule_profiles.

learning_units.description: A free partition of the room's adaptive bulbs, independent of switching groups.

scenes.description: Per-section matrix keyed by learning-unit id x section: per unit per section, mode (auto/off) plus lux margin, maintenance flag, transition, max step. Shape is fixed in P5.

learning_unit.description: Bulbs that share one learned brightness target per section. The almanac key.

schedule_profile.description: A reusable time-section schedule. Section fields arrive with the scheduler port (P5).
